files.name: motion-prompt-137.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Push transition" (プッシュ), one of the names in "Motion graphics moves, part 2".
Motion Prompt #137

What it is: The next scene pushes the current one out
What the sample shows: The next scene slides in from the side and pushes the current one out with it.
Spec:
- Sea scene → mountain scene → sea scene, 2.35 s each. The change runs at 0.45–1.6 s of each half (1.15 s), cubic ease-in-out.
- The two scenes stay joined and move together by the full frame width (539 px); no overlap and no fade.
- Direction: sea→mountain moves left (the next scene enters from the right); mountain→sea moves right.
- A navy line (width 6) marks the seam between the two scenes.
When to use it: Use it to step through slides, photos or steps, when the change should feel continuous and moving forward.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/137.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/motion2.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
